issue_request: FHIR-36649 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and requested ImagingSelection coordinate cardinality 2..* because both x and y are required even for a point.
initial_application: The grouped ImagingSelection update in commit 5c5a620527e102650cad53df57ff594d1706fe2a and merge 471fbc468b8fd5427fcebad076569e16590ac707 applied the 2D/3D coordinate split and tuple-count requirements, but left coordinate min values at 1.
additional_context: ImagingSelection is active in source/fhir.ini. Later Applied FHIR-51645 work in PR HL7/fhir#3729 briefly set 2D/3D coordinate mins to 2/3, then merged commit 6be488465a4c7d957c5cb8a0f9b0a8d00aa3b816 changed both mins back to 1 while retaining required multiple-of-two and multiple-of-three invariants.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current StructureDefinition still rejects incomplete coordinate tuples through isl-7 and isl-8, so a single x coordinate is invalid without reversing later applied source history.
